reason: All 24 bills restrict foreign states or international bodies acting in Israel. UNRWA shutdown/immunity bills (rows 1,2,6,7,8,10,12,15,16,19,23,24) carry about 64% of the weight and are the statement's own example. The rest are the same issue: ban on foreign diplomatic missions in Jerusalem (3,5), shielding Israelis from hostile international institutions or the International Criminal Court (4,17,18,20), taxing or limiting foreign-state donations to NGOs (9,11,21), banning Palestinian Authority activity inside Israel (13), closing Al Jazeera (14), restricting visits by foreign officials to Yad Vashem (22). All are labeled toward the statement. The price (conflict with the UN and allies) matches what these bills risk. The wording follows the guidelines, so no change.
